cases.sentence: Он привел меня обратно ко входу в дом, и я увидел воду, текущую из-под ___ к востоку (фасад дома был обращен на восток).
cases.explain: «храмового порога» — after the preposition «из-под», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He brought me back to the door of the house; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the house eastward, for the front of the house faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the house, on the south of the altar.

cases.sentence: Он вывел меня через ___ и провел меня снаружи к внешним воротам, что смотрят на восток, а вода текла с южной стороны.
cases.explain: «северные ворота» — after the preposition «через», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

cases.sentence: Он вывел меня через северные ворота и провел меня снаружи к ___, что смотрят на восток, а вода текла с южной стороны.
cases.explain: «внешним воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

cases.sentence: Он вывел меня через северные ворота и провел меня снаружи к внешним воротам, что смотрят на восток, а вода текла с ___.
cases.explain: «южной стороны» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

cases.sentence: Там будет обитать ___ всевозможных видов рыб, как и в Великом море .
cases.explain: «великое множество» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

cases.sentence: Там будет обитать великое множество ___ рыб, как и в Великом море .
cases.explain: «всевозможных видов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

cases.sentence: Там будет обитать великое множество всевозможных видов рыб, как и в ___ .
cases.explain: «Великом море» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

cases.sentence: На обоих берегах реки будут расти ___ разных видов.
cases.explain: «плодовые деревья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: By the river on its bank, on this side and on that side, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

cases.explain: «разных видов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: By the river on its bank, on this side and on that side, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

cases.sentence: Граница протянется от моря к Гацар-Енану, по ___ Дамаска, с границей Хамата к северу.
cases.explain: «северной границе» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The border from the sea, shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

cases.explain: «восточная граница» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

cases.sentence: На юге она протянется от Тамары до ___ Мериват-Кадеша, а оттуда по руслу египетского потока к Великому морю.
cases.explain: «самых вод» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

cases.sentence: На западе ___ будет границей до места напротив Лево-Хамата.
cases.explain: «Великое море» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
